rationale: Immersive installation using repeated mirrored planes, path choice, reflection, projection, and sound to make navigation itself the perceptual experience.
notes: Official project page and independent photo documentation support the physical maze/reflection mechanism. This is valuable for HCI/spatial navigation concepts without pretending a web adaptation should literally reproduce the installation.

decision.rationale: Adds a non-screen-native spatial interaction anchor: navigation, repetition, reflection, and partial visibility can inform web/canvas/3D experiences at the mechanism level.
